entries.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
entries.reason: Source-bound low incline draft: wide chest-plane shoulder arc, fixed15deg soft elbows and12.5/12 world arm lengths, two rigid neutral-grip dumbbells, head/back supported and quiet legs. Bench angle30deg and85deg opening are schematic draft choices, not universal ROM prescriptions. Independent technique/native runtime acceptance required.
entries.summary: Open through the shoulders with a fixed soft elbow bend, then hug the same arc closed.

frames.caption: Lie on a low incline bench with feet on the floor; hold two bells over the chest with palms facing each other.
Open slowly in a wide shoulder arc; keep the same soft elbow bend.
Stop at a chest stretch you control, without dropping the shoulders deeper.
Keep the back and head supported and the elbow bend unchanged.
Hug the same arc closed over the chest; keep the bells apart.

entries.name: Incline Cable Flye
entries.reason: Source-bound draft from a 3D model turned 42 degrees: opening the arms wide from above the face with a fixed elbow angle, sweeping back together along the same arc, and pausing briefly at the top.
entries.summary: Lying on an incline bench centered between two low pulleys with a D-handle in each hand and the hands together above the face, keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows as you open the arms in a wide arc, then sweep the hands back together and pause at the top.

frames.caption: Set an incline bench centered between two low pulleys and lie back with a D-handle in each hand, hands together at arm's length above the face.
With a slight, fixed bend in the elbows, open the arms out in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Squeeze the chest to bring the hands back together along the same arc.
Pause briefly at the top with the hands together above the face.
Hold the constant elbow angle at the top before opening into the next repetition.
